integrity: Exact all-parameter proof uses induced odd-star components, a labelled exponential formula, and an explicit support construction; finite enumeration is corroboration, not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Labelled complete bipartite graphs only; this is not an arbitrary-graph optimization algorithm. Comparable older material may exist under odd-star factor or star partition terminology; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Parity-gap spectra and exact enumeration of perfect forests in complete bipartite graphs
